content_units: Best Laptops for a CS Student Under $1,100
All three meet your hard requirements:   under $1,100   and   at least 16 GB RAM  .
Given your priorities—  battery life first, portability second, gaming not important  —the best fit is the   Acer Swift Go 14  .
Ranked Laptop Comparison
Laptop   Price   Weight   Battery   RAM/Storage   Best For   Trade-off
Acer Swift Go 14     $899       1.32 kg       11 hr claimed     16 GB / 512 GB SSD   Best overall for battery + portability   Less storage than Lenovo
Lenovo IdeaPad Pro 5 14   $999   1.46 kg   8 hr claimed   16 GB /   1 TB SSD     Best performance/value balance   Shorter battery life; slightly heavier
ASUS Vivobook 15   $849   1.70 kg   9 hr claimed   16 GB / 512 GB SSD   Lowest price   Heaviest and less portable
1) Acer Swift Go 14
-   Why it ranks first:   It directly matches your top priorities better than the others.
-   Battery life:   Best claimed battery here at   11 hours  .
-   Portability:   Also the lightest at   1.32 kg  , which matters for carrying to class daily.
-   Student fit:   16 GB RAM is enough for coding, browser tabs, IDEs, Docker/light VM use, and coursework.
-   Trade-off:   512 GB SSD is fine for most students, but not as roomy as the Lenovo’s 1 TB.
View model
2) Lenovo IdeaPad Pro 5 14
-   Why it ranks second:   Best if you want more performance headroom and more storage without breaking budget.
-   Strengths:   Ryzen 7 7840HS and   1 TB SSD   make it the strongest option for heavier multitasking, larger projects, local datasets, or longer-term use.
-   Portability:   Still reasonably portable at   1.46 kg  , but not as easy to carry as the Acer.
-   Battery:   The main drawback is the   8-hour claimed battery  , which is the weakest here for your stated priorities.
-   Trade-off:   Great “power buy,” but you are paying more for performance you may not value as much as battery life.
View model
3) ASUS Vivobook 15
-   Why it ranks third:   It is affordable, but it misses your priorities more than the other two.
-   Strengths:   Lowest price at   $849  , still with 16 GB RAM.
-   Battery:   Claimed   9 hours   is decent, but behind the Acer.
-   Portability:   At   1.70 kg  , it is clearly the least portable option.
-   Trade-off:   Bigger chassis may feel less convenient for commuting and campus use, and the savings vs. Acer are not large enough to offset that.
View model
Decision for Student Use
Recommended pick: Acer Swift Go 14
Why:
- Best battery life in the group
- Lightest to carry every day
- Still comfortably within budget
- 16 GB RAM is the key requirement for CS work, and it meets it
Choose Lenovo instead if:
- You expect heavier workloads
- You want   1 TB storage
- You are willing to give up battery life for stronger performance
Choose ASUS only if:
- You want to spend the least
- You do not mind extra weight and a less travel-friendly design

Product Context
This ranking assumes claimed battery figures are compared at face value; real-world battery life usually ends up lower and varies by screen brightness, workload, and configuration.
